title: fix(fields): externalize @object-ui/i18n in vite build to fix SSR
body:
Site build fails during Next.js SSR prerendering with `"dynamic usage of require is not supported"` from the LookupField bundle. The `@object-ui/i18n` dependency (which transitively pulls in `react-i18next` CJS code) was not externalized in the fields Vite config, so it got bundled into dist.

- **`packages/fields/vite.config.ts`**: Added `i18n` to externals; converted from array to regex function matching `@object-ui/components` pattern to properly handle subpath imports

```typescript
// before
external: ['react', 'react-dom', 'react/jsx-runtime', '@object-ui/components', '@object-ui/core', '@object-ui/react', '@object-ui/types', 'lucide-react']

// after
external: (id) => /^(react|react-dom|@object-ui\/(components|core|i18n|react|types)|lucide-react)(\/|$)/.test(id)
```

- **`CHANGELOG.md`**: Documented the fix
